messages.content: Find a service provider who has provided service 10 times before.

function.name: get_service_providers
function.description: Retrieve a list of service providers based on various criteria such as service type, location, ratings, availability, and other attributes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

service_id.description: Unique identifier for the type of service.

district_name.description: The name of the district where the service is required.

sub_district_name.description: The name of the sub-district where the service is required.

rating.description: The minimum average rating of the service provider's review score, on a scale from 1.0 to 5.0. This is a float type value.

start_available_date.description: The start date from when the service provider is available, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'. If no date is provided, the current date and time will be used.

end_available_date.description: The end date until when the service provider is available, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'.

min_age.description: The minimum age of the service provider.

max_age.description: The maximum age of the service provider.

has_late_check_in.description: Indicates if the service provider has a record of late check-in.

has_quality_problem.description: Indicates if the service provider has had problems providing quality service.

is_excellent.description: Indicates if the service provider is considered excellent.

is_cleaning_condo.description: Indicates if the service provider offers condo cleaning services.

is_cleaning_home.description: Indicates if the service provider offers home cleaning services.

is_cleaning_office.description: Indicates if the service provider offers office cleaning services.

is_package.description: Indicates if the service provider offers cleaning packages.

is_subscription.description: Indicates if the service provider offers subscription-based services.

available_for_pet.description: Indicates if the service provider offers services in pet-friendly accommodations.

professional_group_id.description: The identifier for the professional group to which the service provider belongs.

job_qty.description: The number of jobs completed by the service provider.
